example: <RadarChart data={profile} categoryKey="axis" valueKey="value" valueMax={3} valueTicks={[1,2,3]} label={t("profile.title")} />
name: RadarChart

props.description: Three to six same-unit axes; missing, negative or nonfinite values invalidate the whole plot.
props.name: data

props.description: Key for already-translated axis labels; full names remain in the accessible data summary.
props.name: categoryKey

props.description: Key for finite numeric axis values.
props.name: valueKey

props.description: Strictly positive common scale ceiling; zero baseline is fixed.
props.name: valueMax

props.description: Optional positive scale ticks within the ceiling, e.g. [1,2,3] for an ordinal rubric.
props.name: valueTicks

props.description: Show the caption; false retains the accessible name.
props.name: showCaption

props.description: Locale-aware number options; defaults preserve up to 21 significant digits.
props.name: numberFormat

props.description: Message for incomplete or invalid data.
props.name: emptyMessage

props.description: Visible exact-value table or legend beneath the plot.
props.name: footer

tagline: Dependency-free quantitative radar/spider profile with 3–6 axes and an explicit shared zero-based scale. Missing or out-of-domain values are not zero-filled. Not an inferred quality score.
usage: DO use same-unit axes with a disclosed common zero baseline and positive ceiling; invalid data renders the empty state.
DO retain a visible exact-value table in the footer where users compare values; the accessible summary always retains exact localized values.
DO theme grid, geometry and measured two-line axis labels through --radar-chart-* tokens. Full labels remain in SVG titles and the accessible summary.
useCases: Disclosed ordinal assessment rubrics without inferred scores.
